scope: D Neuro / Sensory / Motor / Orthopedics first-learning cognition, source handoff, retrieval, local closure and progressive compression only
rule: Organize the 27 stable Blocks and 356 stable KP identities for learning without changing medical meaning, filling Source gaps, adjudicating Source conflicts, duplicating neighboring Primary owners, inferring Question→Knowledge relations, or manufacturing learner progress.

classes.WHOLE_BLOCK_SOURCE: one compact coherent original-Lecture unit may be consumed continuously before local retrieval
classes.NATURAL_SOURCE_UNITS: a long, visual or multi-center Block uses a small number of genuine Source sub-units; each Source unit may support several Logic Groups
classes.INTEGRATION_PRIMARY: no new continuous Primary Lecture is required; KianOS owns synthesis/retrieval while original Source is revisited selectively for decisive visuals, wording or uncertainty

source_contact_contract.hard_rule: Logic Group count never determines Source-contact count. VISUAL_REQUIRED is a closure/evidence requirement, not automatically a separate device handoff.

visual_contract.rule: When a decisive relation is spatial, first formation requires real original-Source visual contact. Text may orient or later test retrieval but cannot certify a never-seen spatial model.
visual_contract.open_source_debt: Current O1–O5 visual-source gaps remain live Source/asset debt; Learning may declare the requirement but cannot manufacture visual closure.

negative_space: no complete clinical neurology, ophthalmology or ENT curriculum
no complete rehabilitation, sports-medicine, prosthetics/orthotics or external modern orthopedic guideline curriculum
no second Primary for calcium/PTH/VitD, B12, RA immune medicine, common TB/infection, myeloma or tumor-general
no phantom clubfoot content while O12 Source gap remains open
no inferred official-question membership or Question→Knowledge mapping
no silent resolution of N10/N11/O3/O5/O10/O13/O14/O15/O16 Source conflicts
no learner-state or mastery claim from repository construction

repair_return.source_conflict_relevant: Source-context check; do not choose a side by model prior
repair_return.return_rule: after repair, return to the interrupted D mainline; repair evidence does not erase the original observation and does not prove mastery

O13: C common infection/source-control language when available
O14: H21 common TB model and R7 treatment entry when available
O15: H17 RA immune/medical Primary when available
O16: O9 tumor-general; H8 myeloma comparison when available

system_route.external_missing_rule: If an external baseline has not actually been learned, use the smallest-sufficient repair for the current D action; do not manufacture learner completion or a new hard repository dependency.
system_route.flex_rule: Hard legality is intentionally sparse. N6/N7 may swap after N5; N8/N9/N10 may move once N2 and their own true prerequisites are available; N11 requires N5+N8 but not N9/N10; O1/O2 and O8/O9/O10/O12/O13/O14/O15/O16 are not hard-serialized behind the whole prior D route; O3 requires O2+N11; O4/O5 and full O11 require N11; O6/O7 require O2. The default route remains low-switching guidance only.

first_pass_chain: bounded Block / natural Source-unit orientation and stop-line
continuous original Lecture contact in iPad/MarginNote when genuine new Source learning is owned there
one normal return after the relevant natural Source contact
active KP retrieval by accepted Logic-Group learner order
cognition-specific Logic-Group closure; several visual LGs may close after one continuous Source unit
after all Block LGs close: Block Recall
optional non-gating Partial-System Reconstruction at five natural branch checkpoints
after all 27 Blocks are actually learned: final D System Reconstruction
later trusted official System question sweep only after exact D question membership Source boundary closes

partial_system_reconstructions.target: stimulus/command → membrane/axon → synapse/receptor → sensory transduction or NMJ → AP/coding/force output → first failed layer
partial_system_reconstructions.closure: localize a new physiology failure layer without replaying Block titles
localize weakness/numbness before disease name and choose the smallest discriminating evidence

partial_system_reconstructions.target: force + structure → displacement/stability → open/closed + blood supply + nerve/vessel/compartment/cord risk → imaging → reduction/fixation/function
partial_system_reconstructions.closure: route a new trauma case by danger and functional objective rather than eponym

partial_system_reconstructions.target: local tissue/load/blood supply/growth → function loss → acute deficit vs chronic overload/entrapment vs ischemic collapse vs developmental fixation → evidence → treatment window
partial_system_reconstructions.closure: separate focal/chronic orthopedic cases by first failed tissue and time/perfusion/growth mechanism

partial_system_reconstructions.target: pyogenic/TB/degenerative-inflammatory/tumor → tempo + tissue/site → evidence/source control/pathology → stability/neural/function threat → correct owner
partial_system_reconstructions.closure: separate destructive structural disease without duplicating C/B/O9 Primary content

compression.ladder: 356 KP → 128 LG → 27 Block Recall → 5 non-gating PSR → final D System Reconstruction
compression.block_recall_rule: rebuild the governing medical problem; do not recite KP labels

forbidden: claim visual mastery from prose-only recall

compression.second_pass: decisive discriminations + real visual/spatial relations + high-value precision + cases + Wrong/Uncertain/fresh verification; do not replay all 128 LGs by default
compression.late_review: mother model + 5 PSR skeletons + decisive visual maps + conflict/precision boundaries + real personal weak points

A2: high-cervical ventilatory-pump and respiratory-failure interfaces
A3: cord/autonomic bladder and renal/electrolyte neurologic-state interfaces

cross_system_handoff.fine_grain_rule: System-level interfaces are allowed; finer external Block/KP routing fails closed without separate reviewed Current authority.

requirements_if_later_eligible: support mixed Source-contact classes without per-LG bouncing

keep Source conflicts explicit but conditional
projection_boundary.rule: Projection may not rewrite D Learning Logic to fit a contiguous-range loader or existing page schema.
